reason: PR #465 ratified config/upbit_exclusion_taxonomy.json, config/upbit_tradeable_universe_policy.json, and a new config/upbit_asset_identity_registry.json from config/upbit_bounded_identity_evidence.json, an evidence file that failed the CIO's source-authority contract: 28 of its VERIFIED_CANDIDATE entries cited only CoinGecko (a third-party aggregator, never sufficient alone), and its KRW-LIT record conflated Upbit's actual listing (Lighter, a zk-rollup perps DEX) with an unrelated project (Litentry/Heima) that Kraken's own citation described. The CIO issued a MERGE HOLD on PR #465 before this was fixed; PR #465 was merged into main anyway (merge commit 69e1cd27d62ea1f2c871d1d91657b05f11a6e699) after the MERGE HOLD comment was posted. This registry records every exact (path, hash) lineage item downstream of that invalid ratification, fail-closed, for permanent, explicit exclusion from any current read model -- never by broad date/prefix match, only by exact path + exact hash.
